ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR(End_Date__c < Start_Date__c, Required_Level__c < 1, Required_Level__c > 4, Required_Count__c < 1, Weight_Percent__c < 0, Weight_Percent__c > 100)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Use valid dates, a level from 1 to 4, a positive count, and a weight from 0 to 100.
